caption: RefineryLens: fuel and gas prices, cooking gas and deliveries for every Nigerian
say: This is RefineryLens. It helps every Nigerian know what fuel and cooking gas really cost, never run out of gas, and get it delivered. And it gives the businesses behind them a trade hub of their own.

caption: Free for households, drivers and keke riders
say: For households, drivers and keke riders, it's free.

caption: Today's prices in your state, no sign-in needed
say: Today's prices need no sign-in. Pick a state and see what people paid for petrol, diesel, kerosene, cooking gas and CNG in the last three days.

caption: Each price is the middle of at least three people's reports
say: Each figure is the middle of what at least three different people reported, so one wrong report can't mislead you. What sellers charged sits alongside for comparison.

caption: Stations and gas shops: who is selling, queues and the latest prices
say: Stations and gas shops show who is selling right now, how long the queue is, and the latest prices.

caption: People warn each other about short measure and overcharging
say: People can warn each other about short measure or overcharging. Repeated problems show on the station's page, with where to complain formally.

caption: Sign in as a demo household in Lagos
say: Let's sign in as a household in Lagos.

caption: A reminder before the cooking gas runs out
say: Straight away, a reminder: the kitchen gas is likely to run out in a few days.

caption: The gas tracker learns how long a cylinder lasts from each refill
say: The gas tracker learns how long a cylinder lasts from each refill, and sends the reminder by alert, push, SMS or WhatsApp.

caption: Order a refill from verified sellers. Pay on delivery
say: Ordering a refill takes a minute. Only sellers RefineryLens has verified appear, with their price per kilo, deliveries and ratings. You pay the rider when the gas arrives, never in advance.

caption: The seller is alerted at once
say: The seller is told at once.

caption: The seller accepts with the final price
say: On the seller's side, the order is waiting under home gas orders. They accept it with the final price, and the customer is told what to pay.

caption: Live tracking: the seller sends the rider a private link by WhatsApp or SMS
say: Now live tracking. The seller creates a private link for the rider and sends it by WhatsApp or SMS.

caption: The rider opens the link on any phone, no account needed, and taps Start sharing
say: The rider opens it on any phone, with no account, sees the address and the amount to collect, and taps start sharing.

caption: The customer follows the rider live, with distance and arrival time (map images need internet, unavailable in this recording)
say: The customer now follows the rider live, with the distance, a rough arrival time and a button to call. Sharing stops by itself when the delivery is done, and positions are deleted after a week.

caption: Should you convert to CNG? Your monthly saving, worked out
say: And for drivers thinking about CNG, the calculator shows a month on petrol against CNG, and how fast a conversion pays for itself.

caption: For businesses: the trade hub
say: For the businesses that buy, sell and move fuel and gas, there's the trade hub.

caption: Wholesale price board by state, medians across at least three sellers
say: The price board shows what sellers charged in each state, without exposing any one seller's price.

caption: The gas network: terminals, depots, refill plants and CNG stations by state
say: The gas network maps terminals, depots, refill plants and CNG stations in every state, and the nearest supply when a state has none.

caption: Delivery jobs: post a load, compare haulier quotes, track the truck
say: Businesses post loads, compare quotes from hauliers, and track the truck the same way, with the same driver links.

caption: Researched opportunities around the Lekki complex, sized with your own numbers
say: And for growing businesses, researched opportunities around the Lekki complex, each with its sources and a sizing tool that shows its formulas.

caption: RefineryLens: know the price, never run out, and get it delivered. On the web, Google Play and the App Store
say: RefineryLens. Know the price, never run out, and get it delivered. On the web, Google Play and the App Store.
